title: CODEOWNERS by repository
description: Whether each repository declares code owners, repositories without a file first — a yes/no per repository, which is why this is a table and not a chart. A missing file is a lead, not a defect: docs, archive, and meta repositories may have no meaningful owner to name, so relevance is a human call. Checked in the standard locations (root, .github/, docs/).
